Module io.github.brantunger.unruly.core
Package io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.exception

Class RuleExecutionException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
java.lang.RuntimeException
io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.exception.UnrulyException
io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.exception.RuleExecutionException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class RuleExecutionException extends UnrulyException
Thrown by run() when a run fails: because a rule's condition or action failed, or because something outside any rule did.

getRuleName() and getExpressionKind() name the rule and the expression when a condition or action threw, a condition evaluated to something other than a Boolean, an action returned null, or a property an action returned couldn't be set on the output. A fatal Error a listener's beforeEvaluate or beforeExecute callback threw names the rule but no expression. Both are null for a failure that belongs to no rule:

  • the run was interrupted, or passed its deadline, while it waited for a compiled copy of the rules, or while it read them again after a reload, or a close of the engine, closed the list it had read;
  • the run was stopped between rules, or when a condition or action returned, or threw something with no Error anywhere in its cause chain, once the run had to stop, because its thread was interrupted or it passed its deadline; the cause is then an InterruptedException or a TimeoutException. One that threw something with an Error in its cause chain is that rule's own failure instead, so both getRuleName() and getExpressionKind() are set and the cause is what the expression threw;
  • more than one rule matched on a unique-match engine, which the message names;
  • the output supplier threw or returned null;
  • a language threw or returned null when it created a session for the run;
  • a fatal Error left the run from the output supplier, from a language's check of a fact name, or from a listener's beforeRun, afterEvaluate or afterExecute callback: then run() rethrows the error itself, and this exception, which carries it, goes to RuleListener.onRunError(io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.RunContext, java.lang.RuntimeException). One from afterRun is rethrown with no exception and no callback.

  • Method Details

    • getRuleName

      public @Nullable String getRuleName()
      Returns the name of the rule that failed, as Rule.getRuleName() returns it. Unlike the message, it isn't escaped or shortened, so it can be used to look the rule up.
      Returns:
      The rule's name, or null if the failure isn't about one rule (for example the output supplier failed, or the run was stopped)

    • getExpressionKind

      public @Nullable ExpressionKind getExpressionKind()
      Returns whether the rule's condition or its action failed.
      Returns:
      The kind of expression, or null if the failure isn't about a condition or an action, for example a listener or the output supplier failed
